description: Invokes a code interpreter session to run code in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

researchLinks.description: Cracks in the Bedrock: Agent God Mode

securityImplications: Attackers might use InvokeCodeInterpreter to run code in a Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter, where actions execute with the interpreter's own IAM permissions rather than the caller's, escalating their privileges.

simulation.value: aws bedrock-agentcore invoke-code-interpreter --code-interpreter-identifier TrailDiscover --session-id TrailDiscover --name executeCode --arguments '{"language":"python","code":"print(1)"}'
